The James Suckling MasterClass on wine appreciation is now available. Get inside tips from James as you taste and travel through Tuscany with him and join in on a special meal prepared by him and his wife, Marie. Immerse yourself in the world of wine as James walks you through what to appreciate in every bottle.
Wine appreciation isn’t about showing off your knowledge or spending the most money on a bottle of wine. It’s not about snobbery or one-upmanship. It’s about creating memories and enjoying and learning about wine. Wine has the ability to bring people together and to create a story about a specific moment in time.
In this online MasterClass, James will show you some of the world’s most famous vineyards and take you on a journey through Tuscany, tasting wines and talking to the people who make them. He will explain how to cultivate a love of wine and how to understand the backstories in every bottle—history, tradition, and people. It will be an intimate sharing of his techniques and thoughts on wine tasting and wine enjoyment.
Check it out here: www.masterclass.com/jamessuckling SHARE ON: Comment
